newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Friday:
- Time Warner Inc is reorganizing the film operation it inherited in its merger with Turner Broadcasting System Inc.
- Russian Vimpel-Communications A.O. VIP.N is getting ready for a $90 million initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange.
- Two founders of ValuJet Inc each sold one million shares in the airline.
- Motorola Inc's president and chief operating officer has accepted an offer to become chief executive officer.
- Texas Attorney General Dan Morales filed a lawsuit seeking to block the merger of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas with Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Illinois.
- U.S. retail sales grew two-tenths of one percent in October.
- U.S. business leaders are planning to win more modest victories on Capitol hill come next year.
- Treasury bond prices grew after economic indicators showed the country's economy growing at a subdued pace.
